Chapter 6886: Fire Immortal

Chapter 6886: Fire Immortal

Since all of them were golden immortals, Immortal Devourer was confident in a fight. He had cultivated hard and patiently, never devoured before reaching the golden stage.

Despite joining the alliance, he had maintained his dao heart and didn’t fall to the darkness. This established a strong foundation.

On the other hand, the other two have fallen long ago, resulting in dao stagnation. This was the reason why Immortal Devourer was confident in taking over the alliance.

However, his prestige and influence couldn’t compare to that of Controller.

“Judgment is warranted.” Another being descended. All of Stygian nearly sank before the cultivator’s weight.

This person was as large as Devouring Lord and had three bodies. One resembled a dog from hell holding a torch with a nether glow. The other was a scaled serpent. The scales could fall at any second, allowing people to see torrents of blood with wailing souls. This serpent body wielded a heavy sword, capable of crushing a minor world.

The third was a naked statue of a man, holding a mirror with both hands. Its reflection could melt a world in the blink of an eye.

“God Messenger.” The crowd became afraid again after seeing the third messenger.

He upheld the rules of Devouring Alliance since Zhao Dachui’s generation. Given the lawlessness of the devouring path, he kept the members in order.

“All three are here now.” Someone said while staring strangely at Immortal Devourer.

Although these messengers were from the old Devouring Alliance, they were members of Dark Realm now. In Immortal Emperor Gu Chun’s absence, they maintained Dark Realm’s sovereignty along with the five stars.

“Immortal Devourer, is this your rebellion?” God Messenger’s three heads stared at Immortal Devourer.

“How is it a rebellion when I merely wish to lead against the enemies?” Immortal Devourer remained calm.

“Immortal Abyss must follow the rules dictated by Dark Realm.” Controller said.

“What do you all think, Fellow Daoists?” Immortal Devourer turned and asked the crowd.

They hesitated, clearly not wanting to show their stance. Previously, they wanted him to lead more than Penta-stars. Now, the three messengers’ appearance changed their mind.

“Immortal Devourer bravely took the lead against Guardian’s invasion, he deserves the spot.” Mirage spoke up: “Messengers, you three have jurisdiction over the alliance but not when on the battlefield.”

“Yes, Immortal Devourer leads the battle while the three messengers stay on defense, this is the best strategy.” Someone else came along with a blazing aura.

Worst of all, this unbearable heat had the aura of a tribulation.

“Fire Immortal.” Even the vagrant immortals were afraid of him, the same went for the three messengers.

The happiest to see him was Immortal Devourer. This was the key part of his agreement with Fallen Ten.

“Ancestor.” Mirage and Extinguish bowed.
